# dagsterplus_teams (Data Source)

Lists all Dagster+ teams in the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_teams" "all" {}

output "team_names" {
  value = [for t in data.dagsterplus_teams.all.teams : t.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `regex_filter` (String) Regex filter to select teams based on the team name. Regex matching is done using Go's regexp package.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for this data source.
- `teams` (Attributes List) All teams in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams))

<a id="nestedatt--teams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `teams`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The team ID assigned by Dagster+.
- `name` (String) The team name.
